results.name: 12 Bones Chess Night
results.description: A monthly casual chess night for players of all levels, held in the taproom at 12 Bones Smokehouse & Brewing in Arden. Drop-in games and conversation.
results.notes: Monthly Mountain Xpress listings, no independent site. Grey: venue-hosted but chess regulars likely return; kept.

results.name: Alien Music Club
results.description: A Western North Carolina jazz, funk and soul band collective that hosts a monthly jazz jam where local musicians sit in. Players of all levels bring instruments or voices.
results.notes: Own site alienmusicclub.com and Facebook page; sponsors the monthly jam at Turgua.

results.name: Asheville Alignable Alliance
results.description: A monthly free networking event for local entrepreneurs and small business owners, also listed as Asheville Business Connect.
results.notes: Business networking programming, no membership community; excluded per business-development rule.

results.name: Asheville Beer Drinkers, Happy Hours & Bar Hoppers
results.description: A social group that meets at Asheville breweries for midweek happy hours and bar hopping. Open to anyone who wants to meet people over a beer.
results.notes: Meetup group run by organizer with recurring brewery meetups; regulars likely. Grey, kept.

results.name: Asheville Community Mom's Group
results.description: A moms' social group that holds monthly meetups such as park picnics, coffee dates and ice cream socials. Families and kids are often welcome.
results.notes: Meetup group with consistent monthly meetups.

results.name: Asheville Filmmakers and Actors Group
results.description: A group for local filmmakers and film actors to meet, network and share projects. Holds regular meetups and the Let's Film AVL short-film brainstorming sessions.
results.notes: Meetup with 26 events; candidate c:let-s-film-avl is its sub-series and should point here.

results.name: Asheville Language Exchange - English & Spanish
results.description: A monthly conversation meetup where English and Spanish speakers practice with each other, switching languages halfway through the evening.
results.notes: Meetup group with recurring monthly exchange at One World West.

results.name: Asheville Over 55 Singles Dining Out and Conversation
results.description: A social group for singles over 55 who gather for dinners and happy hours at Asheville restaurants and breweries. Members chip in small dues for the organizer.
results.notes: Age-based singles social group; description mentions dues.

results.name: Asheville Singles Over 50 Golf Meetup
results.description: The Asheville chapter of the American Singles Golf Association for singles over 50. Plays nine holes followed by dinner together.
results.home_base: Chestnut Mountain Golf Club, Mills River
results.notes: Local ASGA chapter site cited in Meetup description; 25 recent events.

results.name: Asheville TENS Card Game Group
results.description: A card game group that plays Tens and Spades at small tables, hosted at local cafes and members' homes. Newcomers are welcome.
results.notes: Meetup with repeated Tens nights; hosts rotate.

results.name: Atheists of WNC
results.description: A social group for atheists and freethinkers in Western North Carolina, with regular coffee chats, a book club and outings.
results.notes: Meetup group with 58 events; sister group to WNC Humanists. No independent site found.

results.name: Beyond the Cap Collective
results.description: A monthly mastermind for Keller Williams real estate agents who have reached their commission cap.
results.home_base: Keller Williams Professionals, 48 Grove St, Asheville
results.notes: Brokerage-internal business-development programming for agents; not a community group.

results.name: Books That Age Like Wine
results.description: A book club that reads and discusses classic and enduring novels, meeting at a pizza restaurant in Asheville.
results.notes: Meetup book club with a steady monthly series.

results.name: Chicago Sports Fans Meetup
results.description: A group for Chicago sports fans in Asheville who gather at a local pub to watch Bears and other Chicago team games.
results.notes: Only one event (Dec 2025); fan club identity is plausible. Grey, kept as dormant.

results.name: Creative Moms of Asheville
results.description: A new group for moms to connect over simple art and craft projects in a relaxed setting. No artistic experience needed.
results.notes: Meetup with first gathering Aug 2026; very new, keep and watch.

results.name: Django Jazz Jam with Fatty
results.description: A monthly gypsy jazz jam and guitar workshop at Turgua Brewing where players bring instruments or voices and trade solos in the Django Reinhardt style.
results.notes: Host-led jam; grey, kept because the gypsy-jazz player community returns. Sibling jam at Sovereign Kava is separate.

results.name: Ethical Humanist Society of Asheville
results.description: A non-theist community and member of the American Ethical Union that meets for Sunday programs, talks and discussions on ethics and social issues.
results.notes: Search confirms society founded 2001, meets at 227 Edgewood Rd. No site URL confirmed.

results.name: Friends for the End of the World
results.description: A social group that hosts regular mixers and bar nights to help people meet new friends in Asheville.
results.home_base: Haiku Garden House and bars, Asheville
results.notes: Meetup with 50 events since March 2026.

results.name: Harmony With Humans Across Political Differences
results.description: A one-time paid communication workshop on talking across political differences using Nonviolent Communication tools.
results.notes: Single workshop with a requested $75 donation; no recurring membership.

results.name: Hooping Around Community Basketball
results.description: A free weekly pickup basketball session for ages 16 and up at a community center, with no registration required.
results.home_base: Linwood Crump Shiloh Community Center, Asheville
results.notes: Recurring open gym with regulars likely; run by the community center. Grey, kept.

results.name: Jack's Traditional Irish Session
results.description: A long-running weekly Irish and Celtic music session where local musicians gather to play reels and jigs on the pub stage.
results.home_base: Jack of the Wood Pub, Asheville
results.notes: Pub's long-running session; musician regulars return. 91 events.

results.name: Le Salon de L'Astrologie
results.description: A monthly astrology discussion salon with a transit summary followed by open conversation and questions, hosted by astrologer Frank Salzano.
results.notes: Practitioner-hosted but discussion-circle format; grey, kept. Separate from Asheville Astrology Club.

results.name: Mama Medicine - Women's Gatherings
results.description: Women's gatherings for mothers with sharing circles and seasonal rituals, held in Weaverville.
results.notes: Only one listed event (Dec 2025, $20); practitioner-led circle. Grey, kept as dormant.

results.name: Men in Harmony
results.description: A nonprofit male a cappella chorus singing mainly barbershop style, rehearsing weekly and performing at senior living facilities and community events.
results.notes: Confirmed on mih.harmonysite.com; weekly rehearsals, new men welcome.

results.name: Momentum Collective
results.description: A monthly gathering hosted by Keller Williams Professionals for real estate agents, focused on professional growth.
results.home_base: Keller Williams Professionals, 48 Grove St, Asheville
results.notes: Brokerage-internal agent programming; business-development, not a community group.

results.name: Not Dead Yet: Asheville's Women in Their 50s & 60s
results.description: A social group for women in their 50s and 60s, with brunches, concerts, ball games, music bingo and other outings around Asheville.
results.notes: Meetup age-based social group with 13 events.

results.name: Otterpine Silent Reading Party
results.description: A twice-monthly silent reading night for book lovers, with quiet co-reading and optional socializing at a West Asheville bar. Introvert-friendly.
results.notes: Organized by Otterpine; recurring through Dec 2026. Grey (new series), kept.

results.name: PROpel AVL
results.description: A free social group for meeting people and exploring Asheville, running Connect events at local businesses and breweries.
results.notes: Meetup with four Connect socials in 2026; identity is networking-social, grey, kept.

results.name: Ring of Fire Race Series
results.description: A weekly summer track-style points race for cyclists at the Mellowdrome, with women's open heats and a team component. Run by Asheville on Bikes.
results.notes: Seasonal series by Asheville on Bikes; ended June 2026. Search found no separate site. Grey, kept.

results.name: Shamanic Journey Circle
results.description: A drop-in circle using live drumming to guide shamanic journeying, led by Randi Janelle and tied to seasonal celebrations.
results.notes: Described as ongoing practice community at The Well; facilitator-led, grey, kept.

results.name: Solutions Group
results.description: A peer-led 12 step daily living sober meeting offered through the Asheville 12 Step Club, with online meetings.
results.notes: Meeting listed on sobasearch at the Asheville 12 Step Club; no listings since May 2026.

results.name: Stroke Support Group
results.description: A monthly support group for stroke survivors and caregivers run by Stronger Together Wellness, sharing experiences and coping strategies.
results.notes: Stronger Together Wellness is a nonprofit founded 2025; group listed on stroke.org.

results.name: The Asheville Hiking Group
results.description: A free hiking group that leads hikes of varied length and difficulty across Western North Carolina, open to all skill levels.
results.notes: Meetup group with 181 recent events; no independent site found.

results.name: Toby's Briar & Pipe Society
results.description: A monthly gathering for pipe smoking enthusiasts to share blends and techniques in a cigar bar.
results.notes: Venue-hosted but hobby club identity; Hendersonville is in area. Grey, kept.

results.name: Using AI in Small Business
results.description: A small peer roundtable where local business owners share how they are using AI. Seats are limited to a few participants.
results.notes: One inaugural event (Mar 2026); peer-led, not sales. Grey, kept as dormant.

results.name: Western North Carolina Cribbage Club
results.description: A cribbage club that meets every Monday at the American Legion hall in Waynesville. New players are welcome.
results.notes: Listing says the club meets every Monday; last listed event May 2026.

results.name: WNC MS Support Group
results.description: A monthly support group for people living with multiple sclerosis and their families and care partners to share experiences and information.
results.notes: Mountain Xpress listings show ongoing monthly meetings.

results.name: Women's Circle (Bounty & Soul)
results.description: A women's self-care and peer listening circle led by Bounty & Soul's Latina program, with wellness activities and connection.
results.notes: Event pages on bountyandsoul.org; drop-in, no registration.
